tldr: Mercury through the 11th house brings focus to friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work.
body: Mercury transiting the 11th house activates friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work. For a few weeks, thought, conversation, planning, and messages move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a thinking transit: it favors planning, conversations, edits, decisions, and information-gathering around the house topic.
business: Mercury supports community contribution and future goals: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Overthinking, mixed messages, or belonging without discernment.
advice: Name the details in the 11th house deliberately. Work with friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
